summary: The submission presents Task 1 (Inventory) outlining metadata extraction from 25 documents on AI in the steel industry, defining the knowledge domain and key tools. Task 2 (Topographical Mapping) builds a hierarchical topic tree and a textual network graph, highlighting clusters such as production scheduling, energy efficiency, digital twins, and AI techniques, and identifies gaps. Task 3 (Synthesis Divergence) begins a comparative analysis of traditional versus AI-driven scheduling and energy versus throughput trade‑offs. The work stops abruptly before completing further synthesis or a final report.
issues: Only three of the five expected tasks are present; Tasks 4 and 5 are missing.
The document ends abruptly, suggesting incomplete content.
No bibliography or reference list is included.
No explicit declaration of AI tool usage is found.
